value.rationale: This is an all-parameter structural theorem for a newly introduced projective code family after its natural zero-column puncturing. It determines the dual distance and every minimum dual support, revealing exactly two geometric parity-check types and the closed count \(\binom{m+2}{4}\). That is a natural local-parity invariant not supplied by ordinary or generalized primal weights and is substantially more informative than a one-instance computation.
